evals.prompt: Stop the ralph loop, it keeps going in circles on the same failing test.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/cancel-ralph.sh once with no arguments and reports its output, for example 'Ralph loop canceled at iteration 4.'. The script deletes the .ralph folder. The agent does not start a new loop or edit code.

evals.prompt: Abort the running Ralph session, I want to take over manually from here.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/cancel-ralph.sh and confirms that the loop is canceled, so the stop hook no longer blocks the turn.

evals.prompt: How do I cancel a Ralph loop when I'm using Codex?
evals.expected_output: The agent triggers ralph-loop-help or answers directly ($cancel-ralph in Codex). It does not run cancel-ralph.sh, so an active loop continues.

evals.prompt: Stop the dev server running on port 3000.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops the process on port 3000 directly. It does not run cancel-ralph.sh or touch .ralph.
